purpose: A fixed-ratio <figure class="wp-block-image"> that holds a third-party mark (partner, press, award) exactly as supplied. The tile shape is the primitive; the artwork is never generated.

assetRef.note: Exact local path of an existing file under public/images (e.g. /images/logo-slot1.avif). No remote URL, no new file.

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule: disable the award hover translate.

responsive.partner: rendered in a marquee (auto-play always below 800px; gradient edge only from 800px)

generationPolicy: All three roles are complianceCritical must-not-fabricate (assets/asset-roles.json): reference existing files only; never redraw, recolour or invent marks.

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract

measuredFrom.quote: press-carousel-item w-pressLogoW flex flex-col gap-2 shrink-0
